method: Hand review of design/parity/evidence/<row>/comparison.png (reference, built, pixelmatch diff) against Material Design 3 component anatomy and the checked-in reference.

primitives.finding: Reference: Health score / Breached / Needs work / Healthy tiles in tonal containers; built: Healthy / Weak or short / Found in breaches / Passkeys stored with different counts and colours.
Reference expands each finding into entry rows with URL and a Fix action; built shows count chips and a text notice only.
Built adds a 'Database reports' headline, 'Detailed reports' button and findings dropdown not in the reference.

defects.summary: Summary tile set and finding-row anatomy differ from the reference
Header controls not in the reference
